scope: Area 3 customer profiles; focused read-only SQL/application source review
summary: No concrete defects found. SQL uses fixed empty search paths, restricted execution, default-deny RLS and auth.uid-bound ownership with account locking and permission/revision checks. Application input and DTOs are allowlisted, stale editor subjects are checked against verified identity without becoming SQL targets, and revisions/success follow validated server results.
limitations: Reviewer performed source inspection only; no files modified, tests run or hosted changes made.
Deployment and runtime multi-session concurrency were not independently verified.
